verdict.rationale: QuickBooks vendor docs describe 'Intuit Intelligence' features—chat-based Q&A for insights ('What's driving my profit?'), instant reports, anomaly detection via Payroll AI, and forecasting—directly matching AI-generated insights inside the product. However, all evidence is vendor marketing copy with no independent/community confirmation of these AI features' real-world quality, and some community feedback highlights general product quality complaints, so caveats remain significant.
